_note: Synonym probe: measures grounding false-blocks. Perfect extractions are EXPECTED to be blocked for some of these.

tasks.text: NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 2 um, L = 0.5 um, at room temperature. Id-Vg with VDS = 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in 0.1 V steps. Measure the subthreshold slope. At most 40 points.
NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 2 um, L = 0.5 um, at 27 C. Id-Vg with VDS = 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in 0.1 V steps. Measure the saturation drive current at VGS = 1.8 V. At most 40 points.
NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 2 um, L = 0.5 um, at 27 C. Id-Vg with VDS = 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in 0.1 V steps. Measure the standby current at VGS = 0 V. At most 40 points.
NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 2 um, L = 0.5 um, at 27 C. Id-Vg with VDS = 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in 0.1 V steps. Measure the turn-on voltage. At most 40 points.
